sentences.text:
Opposite Parties
 Mr. S. Behera, Aga
 Coram:
 Mr. Justice R. K. Pattanaik
 Order
Heard Mr. Maharana, learned counsel for the petitioners.

2. Instant writ petition is filed by the petitioners against the impugned action of opposite party Nos.
5 to 7 in sealing the shop rooms and further to direct the later to de-seal the same in order to allow them to carry on their trade and business with such other reliefs sought for.
3. Mr. Maharana, learned counsel for the petitioners submits that without any rhyme or reasons, the shop rooms of the petitioners having trade licenses have been sealed at the instance of opposite party Nos. 5 to 7.

Referring to the notices issued by the Food Safety Officer issued to petitioner Nos.
1 & 2 as at Annexure-4 series, it is claimed that such sealing of the shop rooms is a colourable exercise of power and hence, necessary direction is required to be issued to the opposite parties and in particular, opposite party Nos. 5 to 7.
Considering such submission and in view of the representation i.e. Annexure-5 pending before the authority concerned as per Annexure-5, the Court is inclined to issue notice to the opposite parties.
4. Accordingly, it is ordered.
5. Notices to the opposite parties.

Mr. Ray, learned AGA accepts notice for opposite party Nos. 1, 2, 4 & 7.
6.
Notices to other opposite parties by Registered Post with AD making it returnable at an early date Loknath Sahoo & Others vs State Of Odisha And Others ....

7. List on 21st August, 2025 for final hearing and orders.
(R.K. Pattanaik) Judge 02. 1.
Heard Mr. Maharana, learned counsel for the petitioners.

2. Instant petition is filed by the petitioners for interim orders directing opposite party Nos. 5 & 6 to de-seal the shop rooms standing over the case land allowing them to run the eateries as an interim measure.

3. Awaiting response of the State and Municipality, this Court is not inclined to pass any such orders as pleaded by the petitioners but allows them to remove the perishable and disposable items lying inside the shop rooms presently sealed with the permission of opposite party Nos. 5 to 7.
4.
List on the date fixed for further orders.
5. Urgent copy of this order be issued as per rules.
